pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity and smooth pixel gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the central flank compared to the smaller, more crowded polygons on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial network with prominent trivalent junction nodes. Pathways maintain a consistent pixel thickness, forming a continuous grid that separates individual dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile along the dorsal neck, characterized by high-frequency, short hair-cluster silhouettes against the sky.
